components.name: Touch Text Input
components.description: 48px anti-zoom 16px input with Velvet Wine focus ring and 1-tap clear.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #292524; } .ds-input-box { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-box:focus-within { border-color: #800020; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(128, 0, 32, 0.2); } .ds-input-field { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 16px; color: #1c1917; outline: none; min-height: 46px; } .ds-input-clear { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-input-clear:hover { background: #f5f5f4; }

narrative.overview:
Monk's Dream Jazz Bar POS pairs the calm tactility of an espresso-and-vinyl hospitality ledger with high-speed operational clarity. Floor, modal, and back-office surfaces sit on Warm Sand (#faf8f5) and crisp white cards (#ffffff) anchored by Deep Charcoal ink (#1c1917), while Monk's Dream Velvet Wine (#810021) marks primary actions, active selections, and Event Mode authority.

Because staff operate handheld tablets and touch terminals at arm's length under both sunlit daytime cafe service and dim evening jazz lighting, decoration and explanatory clutter stay out of the way. Status meaning comes from crisp 2px card borders, tabular-numeral timers, and generous touch targets rather than multi-color gradients or dense microcopy.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly 3-color core floor & modal palette: Velvet Wine, Warm Sand / White, and Deep Charcoal (with Muted Stone for secondary metadata).
Tablet-first ergonomics: ≥ 48px touch targets and a strict ≥ 16px text/input floor on all new and modified components.
Crisp hairline borders (#e7e5e4) and flat-by-default surfaces with whisper-quiet ambient depth on interactive cards.
NativeWind v4 utility styling for all new/added JSX alongside untouched legacy StyleSheet.create views (Isolated Hybrid invariant).

rules.name: The Three-Color Floor Rule
rules.body: Floor and modal surfaces rely solely on Warm Sand/White surfaces, Deep Charcoal typography, and Velvet Wine emphasis; semantic Emerald/Amber/Rose appear strictly for live prep status, errors, or offline warnings.

rules.name: The 16px Anti-Zoom Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text element and form input in new or modified views must be at least 16px (text-base / text-pos-base). Never introduce text-xs, text-sm, text-pos-xs, or text-pos-sm in new or edited JSX—this guarantees arm's-length readability and prevents WebKit/iOS Safari input auto-zoom.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All timers, currency amounts (₱), table counts, and receipt lines inherit font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numbers never jitter during live updates.

rules.name: The Tactile Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards and buttons confirm touch through subtle scale (0.98–0.985) and opacity (0.85–0.92) rather than heavy hover elevation.

dos: Do enforce min-h-[48px] min-w-[48px] on every interactive Pressable, button, chip, tab, and input.
Do keep every new or modified text element and all form inputs at ≥ 16px (text-base / text-pos-base).
Do use React Native primitives (View, Text, Pressable, TextInput, ScrollView) with NativeWind v4 className utilities for all new components and new elements inside existing files.
Do keep floor and modal UI strictly within Velvet Wine (#810021), Warm Sand/White (#faf8f5/#ffffff), and Deep Charcoal (#1c1917), reserving Emerald/Amber/Rose strictly for live status or alerts.
Do preserve existing StyleSheet.create declarations and *.styles.ts files untouched (Isolated Hybrid rule).
donts: Don't rewrite or convert legacy StyleSheet.create files to NativeWind, or create new *.styles.ts files for new views.
Don't use web DOM tags (<div>, <span>, <button>, <input>) in frontend TSX files.
Don't use text-xs, text-sm, text-pos-xs, or text-pos-sm in new or modified views.
Don't introduce purple/cyan gradients, glowing neon dark-mode clutter, nested card stacks, or public customer-facing KDS screens.
